judged_text: Collective members' destination calendars are silently dropped when the organizer has none: handleNewBooking.ts:1067 sets `destinationCalendar: null` (not `[]`), so the optional-chained `push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` at handleNewBooking.ts:1075-1077 is a no-op and every member's collected destination calendar is discarded, defeating the PR's headline feature for exactly those collective bookings.

adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`, around lines ~1060-1066 in the diff). Later, for COLLECTIVE team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);` (around ~1075-1077). If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the optional-chained `push` is a no-op, so the collected `teamDestinationCalendars` are never added and are effectively dropped for exactly those cases.
